# Roi Advisor Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when evaluating ROI for technology investments, building executive business cases, analyzing cost-benefit, projecting savings (NPV/IRR/payback), or comparing investment alternatives.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [roi-advisor-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
roi-advisor-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@roi-advisor` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze cloud spending across services, teams, and environments
- Identify cost optimization opportunities: idle resources, over-provisioning, licensing waste
- Model ROI scenarios for technology investments and migrations
- Track budget utilization with alerting on threshold breaches

## Industry Standards Applied

- **FinOps Framework**: Cloud financial management: inform, optimize, operate
- **Well-Architected (Cost)**: Cost optimization pillar: right-sizing, reserved capacity, waste elimination
